name: ocaml-lsp
description: OCaml Language Server for Claude Code

hooks.command: case "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_AUTO_INSTALL:-true}" in [fF][aA][lL][sS][eE]|0|[nN][oO]|[oO][fF][fF]) ;; *) command -v ocamllsp >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v opam >/dev/null 2>&1 || opam exec -- ocamllsp --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || opam install -y ocaml-lsp-server || true ;; esac

auto_install.title: Auto-install language server
auto_install.description: When ocamllsp is not available, install ocaml-lsp-server into the current opam switch at session start (requires opam; the first build can take minutes). Turn off to manage ocamllsp yourself.
